title: Quick Crispy Uruguayan Black Olive Empanadas
description: A crispy and savory Uruguayan dish featuring black olives, perfect for a romantic evening, and suitable for Jain-friendly diets as it does not contain any animal products or by-products.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour and salt.
Gradually add the water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of chopped onion and a few black olives in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with vegetable oil.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
